decision: Selected the Ryhti reference point of permanent building 1042877565, the 58,290 m2 three-storey data-centre hall of Forssa building permit 061-2026-38 (Ryhti permit 302409173L) on property 61-13-585-1 at Rytökallio (Masmalokatu), as the campus locator for the QTS Forssa data-centre campus of Green 3 (Finland) Oy. It locates that building's register point; it is not a footprint, the 44 ha property, a works extent, an entrance or a claim that work is taking place at the point.

selected_properties.main_purpose: code 02 (office, production, utility and other buildings)
selected_properties.address: Masmalokatu 1, 30300 Forssa (Ryhti open_permit_address record linked by building_key; local_data/country-research-nordics-cee-new-p6/ryhti-forssa-masmalokatu-addresses-20261107.json). The 4 November 2026 notice and site plan give the property's address for the DC 02 application as Masmalokatu 4.

identity_bridge: City of Forssa project page 'Datakeskushanke' (live copy captured 7 November 2026; Internet Archive copy of 24 October 2026): Green 3 (Finland) Oy's first building-permit application, for one data-centre hall, a substation and a maintenance/service building at Rytökallio on property 61-13-585-1, Masmalokatu 1, was decided on 23 July 2026 as building permit 061-2026-38; the page calls the project the QTS data-centre project ('QTS-datakeskushanke') and says QTS will operate the data centre.

Ryhti permit 302409173L (per-building DVV permit identifiers 06100026-00380012607 to 06100026-00380042607) on property 06101305850001, decided 23 July 2026, carries four new-building records: 58,290 m2 / 1,192,255 m3 in three storeys (1042877565), 2,400 m2 (104287768J), 150 m2 (104287770L) and 27 m2 (104287769K), all still planned with no start date; each is addressed Masmalokatu 1. A property-wide Ryhti query returns the same four records only.

The Arup/QTS site plan attached to the 4 November 2026 notice (drawing dated 30 October 2026, title 'FIN1-DC01 Masmalokatu 4', EUREF-FIN GK24) shows the earlier permit 061-2026-38 as RAK1 to RAK4, with the data-centre hall (RAK2) at 58,290 m2, and the applied-for DC 02 hall (RAK5) at 58,290 m2 / 1,192,255 m3 in three storeys on the same 439,798 m2 property, so DC 02 is a second hall of the same campus, not a separate site.

City of Forssa notice Kuulutus 131/2026 (4 November 2026): Green 3 (Finland) Oy has applied for a building permit for data building DC 02 on property 61-13-585-1, Masmalokatu 4; the project is subject to the EIA 'Forssan datakeskus'.

consistency_checks.pyproj_check_note: Independent EPSG:3067 to WGS84 transform (pyproj 3.7.1, PROJ 9.5.1, always_xy) agrees with the service's WGS84 output within 3e-8 degrees for all four records (largest difference 2.5e-08 degrees).
consistency_checks.other_masmalokatu_1_address_point_note: A fifth Ryhti address point 'Masmalokatu 1' (record modified 3 November 2026) is linked to a building that is not in permit 302409173L or in the property query; it lies 374 m from the selected point and is not used.

transform_check: No Atlas transformation: the WGS84 point is Ryhti's own output; an independent pyproj check of the native EPSG:3067 point agrees.
